calls.prompt:
Create ONE 2D fighting-game CHARACTER REFERENCE SHEET of Lumi Sorrelle (the Illusionist), an ORIGINAL character for an original
indie fighting game. It must NOT resemble any existing anime, manga, game or film character.

The FIRST attached image is the approved HOUSE STYLE (another character of this game): copy its rendering exactly - the same
premium high-detail anime fighting-game sprite style, line work, cel shading, metal highlights, proportions, scale and the
same kind of sheet layout - but draw Lumi Sorrelle, NOT the character shown there. The SECOND attached image is Lumi Sorrelle's portrait:
match the face, hair, colours and costume from it.

THE CHARACTER:
A slim, playful illusionist in her early twenties with a sly half-smile, large calm violet eyes and pale porcelain skin. Short PASTEL PINK bob (bubblegum pink with rose shadows) with a fringe swept across the brow, the ends curling under at the jaw, and a stray curl on top. A CRIMSON high-collared academy coat in blood-red velvet, cropped at the waist in front and falling into a long flared hem behind, lined in dark maroon, with tarnished gold braid and a gold star clasp at the chest. Under it a WHITE ruffled blouse with a crimson bow at the throat. Plum-black pleated skirt, dark stockings and black knee-high boots with gold buckles. Gold filigree cuffs at both wrists and small glowing violet sigils on both palms. WEAPON: a slender ivory staff, a little taller than her head, with gold bands, held low in the RIGHT hand; the left hand joins it for heavy strikes. Its crown is a four-point star crystal of deep violet glass in a gold claw, with a bright pale-violet core. Magic and trails are VIOLET STARLIGHT with pink-white sparkles; the charged orb is a deep violet sphere with tiny stars inside.

ART STYLE: Premium, high-detail anime 2D fighting-game sprite art: the look of a carefully hand-pixelled character sprite rendered at high resolution - crisp deliberate dark outlines (not thick black cartoon lines), cel shading with three to four tones per material, bright specular highlights on metal, a cool rim light, an expressive face with a clear eye, anatomically correct hands with readable fingers, convincing anime anatomy, fluid hair and cloth that follow the motion. Exactly the rendering, palette and level of detail of the attached reference sheet. Not vector art, not blurry, not chibi, no photorealism.

SHEET CONTENT (transparent background, image 1536x1024, no text, no labels, no grid lines, every figure separate):
- top row: full-body neutral stance facing right with the staff held low in the right hand; a combat stance with the staff raised; a walking pose with the crimson coat hem swaying; a running pose; a jump with the coat flaring; a close-up of the staff's star crystal crown
- middle rows: six casting poses: violet bolts launched from the crystal crown, a two-handed overhead swing releasing a violet crescent, a charged violet orb held in the staff head, a downward plunge with the staff tip toward the ground, an aerial sweep scattering violet star shards
- bottom row: guard with the staff across the body, a hit reaction, knocked down, a victory pose holding the staff upright, the Starfall pose with three falling stars above
Every figure faces RIGHT (three-quarter side view like the house style), the same scale (standing height about 240 px), feet on
the same ground line within each row.
